jumps.name: Additional restructuring/layoff disclosure
jumps.reason: Workday disclosed its second 2026 layoff round (~500 roles, product/tech team) on 2026-09-29 via an 8-K (items 2.02/2.05); the note flags a further round as a watch item even though the current cuts read as cost discipline.

annual_probability.cite: Two layoff rounds have already occurred in 2026 per the note; 0.25 assumes roughly one further such disclosure is plausible within the next 12 months, in the absence of a tagged analogue in the mc-inputs event table (no 'restructuring' event type present).

impact.cite: No analogue available; a further cost-cutting disclosure is assumed modestly negative on headline risk (-5%), well inside the +/-30% assumption bound, since operating margin has been rising through prior rounds (fact sheet Quality table: FY2026 operating margin 10.7%, TTM 12.0%).

jumps.assumption: No historical analogue for a standalone restructuring/layoff-disclosure shock in WDAY's weekly history; impact of -5% is an assumed, bounded placeholder reflecting headline risk from a further cost-cutting round, not a worsening of the fundamentals already improving margins.
